summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for type inference and coercion in parsed data (post-parse normalization stage). It does not semantically match any existing skill in the registry. Existing skills address codec generation, thread pool submission, and streaming I/O—none of which cover automatic type detection and coercion for delimiter-separated value parsers. Peer candidates (grouping, reduction, indexing) operate on iterables at the data_preparation stage and are orthogonal to type coercion. The candidate has clear support from d3-dsv API documentation and no conflicts.
